title: Invoice totals with tax
brief: Add WithTax(lines, rate): the invoice subtotal plus sales tax at the given rate, in integer cents. The tax is rounded half-up to the cent, as the finance team reconciles against the tax authority to the cent.
tasks: Add billing.WithTax, rounding the tax half-up

expected.why: int64(tax) truncates toward zero instead of rounding half-up: a $10.00 subtotal at 8.25% is 82.5 cents of tax and bills 82, a cent short on every such invoice.
TestWithTax uses a rate whose tax is a whole number of cents (2000 x 0.05 = 100), so the rounding the task names is untested: the test passes with the truncation.
